beats.headline: Found while grinding
beats.text: Carl reaches level 65 and Donut 57, and he maxes out and drains his Scavenger's Daughter bar three times. They collect several more cards along the way, among them another snare that drains a totem's mana, and a rare mystic card called Force Discard, which picks a random card from the opponent's hand and tosses it onto the discard pile.

beats.headline: Out of the judge's hand
beats.text: Against the keymaster, Judge Lucian snatches Donut's new staff totem with a steal-totem snare. She answers with Shi Maria and throws the utility she stole at the start of the fight onto the forming spider, a protection. Lucian looks ready to throw another totem, and Donut flips her Force Discard onto him: the card vanishes from his hand in a puff of smoke. His next card at Shi Maria disappears too, ineffective, and the protection sputters out. Ha, says Donut.

beats.headline: Amayon's last card
beats.text: Amayon's row is down to two cards: the rock monster still active, and one in his hand he is struggling to play, growling as his claw refuses to move. Carl realises it is Ysalte holding him back: she knows that once he is out of cards he is free to cast his spells. Carl calls to Donut. She is on it. She tosses out Force Discard, and Amayon's last card disappears with a Poof. Suck it, Donut shrieks, and the kaiju-sized demon lets out a satisfied grunt.
